summary:
Iteration 35 — Σύνολο ERP landing + auth review (mobile 390x844 & desktop 1920x800). Real preview URL ae3b8df7…preview.emergentagent.com. LANDING renders new petrol/off-white editorial design with brand 'Σύνολο ERP', persona toggle (business/office), 18 feature cards, pricing (Μηνιαία/Ετήσια) and FAQ. NO 'pending/coming soon' badges observed. HOWEVER: (P0) LOGIN, FORGOT-PASSWORD SUBMIT BUTTONS ARE STUCK DISABLED FOREVER on desktop AND mobile — button text remains 'Προετοιμασία φόρμας…' with disabled=true & aria-busy=true even after 18s of wait post networkidle. This is the useSyncExternalStore hydration guard in SubmitButton (auth-forms.tsx:26-34) that never flips to 'ready'. Verified real login flow BLOCKED: force-removing disabled attr and clicking submits a plain POST that does NOT create a tc_session cookie (no server-action handler attached). Users cannot log in via UI. Notably /accountant-signup uses the same SubmitButton and IS enabled (button 'Δημιουργία λογαριασμού γραφείου' clickable) — so bug is scoped to LoginForm/ForgotPasswordForm subtree (possibly caused by SSR-time hydration error somewhere in that tree; landing has confirmed hydration mismatches in PlanCards aria-pressed/data-testid and office phone vs plain text, per frontend dev-server logs). (P0-typography) Mobile hero

Landing document overflow OK (scrollW==clientW==390 on mobile). No owner credential mutation attempted; no session injection used. critical_code_review_comments: auth-forms.tsx SubmitButton uses useSyncExternalStore(subscribeHydration, () => true, () => false) with a no-op subscribe. This is a valid isHydrated pattern, but on the /login subtree it never transitions to true. Suspect: hydration error higher up (PlanCards mismatch, office-page mismatch) OR the LoginForm useActionState first-render error prevents commit. Recommend: replace with a mount-flag: `const [ready, setReady] = useState(false); useEffect(() => setReady(true), []);` — much more resilient than useSyncExternalStore and works even if a sibling client component throws.

PlanCards mode='marketing' renders on the server without aria-pressed/data-testid attributes; the client-only variant adds them — causes hydration warning. Ensure the marketing variant produces identical attributes SSR and CSR (or wrap in a suppressHydrationWarning if intentional).
Office employees table renders <a href='tel:…'> conditionally; SSR/CSR differ. Ensure the phone cell renders the same on both sides (perhaps a client-only guard).
Mobile typography: introduce a media query at max-width: 480px lifting hero description to 16px, side description to 15px, form label/button to 15px per spec.

rca_of_issue: auth-forms.tsx SubmitButton relies on useSyncExternalStore to detect hydration. When any client component inside the LoginForm/ForgotPasswordForm subtree throws or the tree gets a mismatch abort, React does not commit the client render, so getSnapshot() (which returns true) is never called on client, and the button stays with the server snapshot (false → disabled + 'Προετοιμασία φόρμας…'). PlanCards hydration mismatch is a strong candidate for the abort trigger (not on /login page itself, but the pattern indicates the codebase has other client-only branch conditions). A more robust fix is a plain useState(false)+useEffect(()=>setReady(true),[]) — this always commits after hydration regardless of nearby mismatches.
